outcome: Placental histopathological lesions (chronic inflammation, histological chorioamnionitis, umbilical/chorionic vasculitis, maternal vascular malperfusion, chorangiosis, villous dysmaturity)
cohort: The study included 54 singleton pregnancies complicated by GDM and 33 gestational age-matched normal pregnancies.
finding: GDM pregnancies were associated with a significantly higher prevalence of various placental histoarchitectural abnormalities and an increased risk of fetal complications, including macrosomia and fetal growth restriction.
cross-section timing: At birth/post-delivery (for placental analysis and primary birth outcomes)
